user.title: Connect to LazyVolt Cloud
user.description: Enter the email and password you use to log in to {lazyvolt_url}. The edge name is how this Home Assistant instance will appear in your LazyVolt dashboard.

data_description.edge_name: Must be unique per charger. Reusing a name disconnects the edge that already uses it.

peblar.title: Select Peblar charger
peblar.description: Select which Peblar charger LazyVolt should control.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to LazyVolt Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: LazyVolt Cloud no longer accepts the token for edge {edge_name}. Log in again to keep controlling your charger.

abort.no_peblar: No Peblar integration found. Please set up the Peblar integration first.
abort.already_configured: Every Peblar charger is already controlled by LazyVolt.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to LazyVolt Cloud. Check the URL and try again.
error.edge_name_in_use: Another LazyVolt entry already uses this edge name.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.
